question: What is the size of the monthly Vibe Code budget on the Mistral Free plan, and does the Pro figure of USD 300 (EUR 255 in the euro view) hold today?
why: no first-party page states a size; the Subscription panel behind a sign-up shows it. Users report Pro Vibe Code usage metered as a currency amount against USD 300 a month (snapshot of 2026-08-18) or EUR 255 (article of 2026-10-10), separate from USD 30, now USD 25.5, of API and Studio usage; a user quoting vendor support says the budget is monetary and not a token count. No Free figure was found. The unit is currency, so no token or session count exists to record
